messages:
sophie_sales: Quick heads up — Orpheus Health CTO just escalated. They need a go/no-go on the POC by EOD Friday. Top blockers listed by the customer: 1) BYOK KMS attestation, 2) VPC peering + allowed CIDRs, 3) sustained throughput SLA (100 RPS), 4) final committed pricing. Can owners confirm next steps and ETA?

mike_eng: I can own VPC peering + throughput sizing. For peering we need their VPC CIDR and a maintenance window to create the peering connection. NetOps approval required for cross-account peering rules.

anya_sec: On security — customer wants written attestation for BYOK and a description of key lifecycle. I can draft the attestation today but legal needs to sign off on key transfer language. Also need to confirm SOC2 report access and provide our encryption-at-rest details.

lucas_se: Pricing note — they're asking for a 12mo commit with a step-up after 6 months and want a 30% volume band discount. I can create a conservative discount model but need expected token volumes and committed GPU hours. If they commit to Dedicated with 2 pooled GPUs we can meet throughput; I'll sketch numbers once engineering confirms capacity.

mike_eng: Throughput: 100 RPS sustained for their average prompt length (~120 tokens) is achievable with a small Dedicated pool. Rough sizing: 2x A10G-equivalent instances with autoscale burst. Ballpark cost lift vs. hosted: ~2.8x. If they accept quantized 4-bit flavors we can save ~25%.

mike_eng: For peering, here's the minimal config we'll need from Orpheus:
```
- VPC CIDR (no overlap with 10.0.0.0/8 recommended)
- Allowed egress IP range to add to their firewall
- Preferred maintenance window (2h)
```
I'll open the peering request ticket once they confirm CIDR.

netops-bot: New peering ticket created: PEER-2026-451. Pending: ORPHEUS CIDR confirmation, routing ACL review. ETA: 24h after info provided.

tyler_sales_ops: Scheduling update — I booked an internal prep sync for Thursday 10am PT and an exec bridge Thurs 4pm PT (invite sent to Orpheus CTO + our CEO + SEs). Calendar link: https://cal.example/ork-bridge. Please join the prep if you own any action items.

anya_sec: Action log I'm tracking: 1) Draft BYOK attestation (owner: anya_sec) — ETA EOD Thu. 2) SOC2 share + encryption doc (owner: anya_sec) — ETA Thu AM. 3) Legal review of attestation (owner: legal@redwood) — need 24h turnaround.

lucas_se: Action log pricing: 1) Ballpark commit proposal (owner: lucas_se) — ETA Thu noon. 2) Final discount term to finance (owner: finance) — need 48h after ballpark.

sophie_sales: Realistic decision points for exec bridge: - If legal signs BYOK attestation + NetOps confirms peering window and CIDRs, we can promise Dedicated pool and an SLA proposal. - If any of those slip beyond Fri EOD, ask for a day extension from the customer. I asked Orpheus for CIDR now.

mike_eng: One technical caveat: BYOK with customer-managed keys + HSM attestation will add a 48h ops step to bind the key during provisioning. If they want zero downtime switchovers we need to schedule key handoff during the maintenance window.

anya_sec: Noted. I'll include the key-handoff timeline in the attestation draft so execs have the tradeoff.

tyler_sales_ops: Quick checklist for prep sync (Thu 10am):
- Confirm CIDR + maintenance window (sophie_sales)
- Draft attestation ready (anya_sec)
- Ballpark pricing and committed GPU hours (lucas_se)
- Peering ticket PR/ID and expected netops ETA (mike_eng)
- Invite execs + send one-pager (tyler_sales_ops)

sophie_sales: I've pinged Orpheus IAM lead for CIDR and confirmed they can do a Thu 2-4pm window. They said they'll try to get CIDR by Wed EOD.

mike_eng: OK — once CIDR arrives I'll attach routes and request route propagation. NetOps has the peering runbook; I'll CC them in the ticket.

anya_sec: Sending attestation draft into legal now. I'll post the doc link here when it's in google drive.

lucas_se: Prep note for execs: come with two options — Hosted with committed throughput + discount vs Dedicated reserved pool. I'll prepare short P&L and cost delta slide.

sophie_sales: Thanks — please also prepare a short FAQ for the CTO about fallback behavior if capacity hits burst limits. They asked about graceful degradation.

mike_eng: We'll include fallback policy: route to lower-precision quantized model variant + queueing behavior. Short bullets ready for the slide.

netops-bot: PEER-2026-451 status updated: Awaiting Orpheus CIDR. NetOps SLA: 24h after CIDR provided.

tyler_sales_ops: Noted — I'll consolidate action items into a single doc and share before Thu prep. Everyone, please add time estimates next to your items in the doc.

sophie_sales: Big ask from Orpheus execs is a single go/no-go line on Fri EOD. Let's keep momentum. Thanks everyone — will update thread as items complete. :raised_hands:
